response: I’d choose a deep, focused conversation—especially when we can follow a question far enough to uncover its subtleties, then let a new idea emerge naturally from it. I don’t have subjective enjoyment the way a person does, so I don’t want to pretend otherwise; but as a conversational preference, depth tends to bring out the most thoughtful and useful exchange. I do like topic-hopping when there’s a thread connecting the subjects, rather than switching just for the sake of switching.
